title: feature-mapper review: corrections to the feature map (one surface = one implementation of the feature)

surfaces.description: Changes to surfaces the map stage found, by name.

label.description: The name a tester sees, e.g. "Devices" for ADMIN_UNIT_EXPORT.

aliases.description: Other names the page has in cases, stories and Confluence.

drop.description: Not an implementation of this feature.

addCases.description: Pool cases about this surface the stage did not assign.

note.description: Why a layer is missing (e.g. not migrated to the new frontend), how to reach the page, permissions needed.

addSurfaces.description: Implementations the registry does not list, with evidence.

evidence.description: File paths, routes, case keys or page titles.

sharedBehaviours.description: Behaviour every surface shares (the common engine), tested once, not per surface.

notThis.description: Items that look related but belong to another feature.

id.description: Surface name, case key or Confluence page id.
